proof_summary: After factoring out \(b\), choose carries \(c_j\in\{0,-1\}\) so that \(d_j=\sigma_j+c_j-bc_{j+1}\) always belongs to \(\{0,1,b-2,b-1\}\); the resulting identity telescopes to a base-\(b\) digit representation. If the terminal carry is negative, taking the absolute value invokes the base-\(b\) complement identity: complementation preserves the allowed digit set, and the added \(1\) changes only the least digit from \(d_0\in\{1,b-1\}\) to \(b-d_0\in\{b-1,1\}\).
